title: Present continuous and present simple for the future
summary: Present continuous для личных договорённостей и present simple для расписаний и программ; present simple в придаточных времени и условия (when, as soon as, until, if, in case) вместо will; случаи, когда will в придаточных всё-таки возможно.
ru:
## Present continuous: личные договорённости
Когда мы говорим о **будущем, которое уже организовано**, у нас есть время, место и, как правило, другие участники, используем **present continuous**. Часто рядом стоит указание времени.
> I'm meeting my accountant on Thursday. — В четверг я встречаюсь с бухгалтером. (договорились)
> They're moving to Lisbon in September. — В сентябре они переезжают в Лиссабон.
> What are you doing this weekend? — Что вы делаете в выходные?
Особенно часто так говорят глаголы движения и действия, связанные с планами: **go, come, leave, arrive, fly, meet, see, have (lunch), play**. Но решение, принятое в момент речи, и предположения сюда не относятся: ~~It's raining tomorrow.~~ → It **will rain** / **is going to rain**.

## Present simple: расписания и программы
**Present simple** используем для событий, которые **определены расписанием, календарём, программой или официальным графиком**, а не личным желанием.
> The train to Prague leaves at 6.40 tomorrow. — Поезд в Прагу отправляется завтра в 6.40.
> The conference starts on Monday and finishes on Wednesday. — Конференция начинается в понедельник и заканчивается в среду.
> Tomorrow is Friday. — Завтра пятница.
В организационных ситуациях present simple допустим и для людей: **The Prime Minister arrives in Berlin on Sunday and meets the Chancellor on Monday.** — звучит как программа визита.

## Разница оттенков
Сравните два предложения об одном и том же:
> The film starts at eight. — Фильм начинается в восемь. (афиша, расписание)
> We're going to the cinema at eight. — Мы идём в кино в восемь. (наш план)
Present simple с личным планом возможен только при чёткой договорённости и обычно в официальном тоне: **I leave for Geneva on Friday.** — звучит почти как деловое сообщение. В разговоре чаще **I'm leaving for Geneva on Friday.**

## Present simple в придаточных времени и условия
После **when, as soon as, once, after, before, until, by the time, while, if, unless, in case, provided (that), as long as** будущее выражается **present simple**, а не will.
> I'll text you as soon as I land. — Напишу, как только приземлюсь.
> Don't open the file until the system tells you to. — Не открывайте файл, пока система не скажет.
> Take a coat in case it gets cold. — Возьми пальто на случай, если похолодает.
> If the results are positive, we'll publish them. — Если результаты окажутся положительными, мы опубликуем их.
Можно использовать **present perfect**, чтобы подчеркнуть завершённость: **I'll call you when I've finished.**

## Когда will в придаточном всё же возможен
**Will** допустим, если он сохраняет собственный смысл «готовность», «согласие» или стоит в придаточном дополнительном (после wonder, know, ask):
> If you'll help me, I'll finish sooner. — Если вы согласитесь помочь... (will = согласие, вежливо)
> I don't know when the results will arrive. — Не знаю, когда придут результаты. (придаточное дополнительное, не времени)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'll tell you when I will know.~~ → I'll tell you when I **know**.
- ~~What do you do tonight?~~ → What **are you doing** tonight?
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay in.~~ → If it **rains**, we'll stay in.
- ~~The match is starting at 3 tomorrow~~ (по расписанию) → The match **starts** at 3 tomorrow.
en:
## Present continuous: personal arrangements
When we talk about a **future that is already organised** - there is a time, a place, usually other people involved - we use **present continuous**. A time expression is often present.
> I'm meeting my accountant on Thursday. (we have agreed)
> They're moving to Lisbon in September.
> What are you doing this weekend?
This is especially common with verbs of movement and activity linked to plans: **go, come, leave, arrive, fly, meet, see, have (lunch), play**. But a decision made at the moment of speaking, and predictions, do not belong here: ~~It's raining tomorrow.~~ → It **will rain** / **is going to rain**.

## Present simple: timetables and programmes
We use **present simple** for events fixed by **a timetable, a calendar, a programme or an official schedule**, not by personal wishes.
> The train to Prague leaves at 6.40 tomorrow.
> The conference starts on Monday and finishes on Wednesday.
> Tomorrow is Friday.
In organisational contexts present simple is possible for people too: **The Prime Minister arrives in Berlin on Sunday and meets the Chancellor on Monday.** - it sounds like a programme of the visit.

## A difference of tone
Compare two sentences about the same thing:
> The film starts at eight. (the listing, the schedule)
> We're going to the cinema at eight. (our plan)
Present simple for a personal plan is possible only if it is firmly fixed, and it usually sounds formal: **I leave for Geneva on Friday.** sounds almost like a business notice. In conversation **I'm leaving for Geneva on Friday** is more usual.

## Present simple in time and condition clauses
After **when, as soon as, once, after, before, until, by the time, while, if, unless, in case, provided (that), as long as** we use **present simple** for the future, not will.
> I'll text you as soon as I land.
> Don't open the file until the system tells you to.
> Take a coat in case it gets cold.
> If the results are positive, we'll publish them.
We can use **present perfect** to stress completion: **I'll call you when I've finished.**

## When will can appear in the clause
**Will** is possible if it keeps its own meaning of 'willingness' or 'agreement', or if the clause is an object clause (after wonder, know, ask):
> If you'll help me, I'll finish sooner. (will = agree to; polite)
> I don't know when the results will arrive. (an object clause, not a time clause)

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'll tell you when I will know.~~ → I'll tell you when I **know**.
- ~~What do you do tonight?~~ → What **are you doing** tonight?
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay in.~~ → If it **rains**, we'll stay in.
- ~~The match is starting at 3 tomorrow~~ (a schedule) → The match **starts** at 3 tomorrow.
structure:
## Формулы
> **am/is/are + V-ing** + время → личная договорённость
> I'm seeing the dentist on Friday.

> **V (present simple)** + время → расписание, программа, календарь
> The bank opens at nine tomorrow.

> **when / as soon as / until / if / in case ... + present simple**, ... **will** + V
> I'll call you when I get there.

> **when / after / once ... + present perfect**, ... will + V
> We'll start as soon as everyone has arrived.

## Сравнительная таблица
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Личный договорённый план | present continuous | We're having dinner at eight. |
| Расписание, программа | present simple | The film starts at eight. |
| Придаточное времени | present simple | I'll leave before it gets dark. |
| Придаточное условия | present simple | If it rains, we'll stay home. |
| Завершённость в придаточном | present perfect | Call me when you've arrived. |
| Согласие (will в if) | will | If you'll wait here, I'll check. |
| Придаточное дополнительное | will | I wonder when she will come. |

## Слова-маркеры придаточных
| Время | Условие |
|---|---|
| when, as soon as, once, after, before, until, by the time, while | if, unless, in case, provided (that), as long as, suppose |

exercises.title: Present continuous или present simple?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в present continuous или present simple.
exercises.example: I (meet) the architect at three tomorrow. → I'm meeting.

items.text: I {{am meeting|'m meeting}} the architect at three tomorrow.
The train to Vienna {{leaves}} at 7.45 tomorrow morning.
I'll call you as soon as the results {{come in|arrive}}.
We {{aren't flying|are not flying|'re not flying}} to Oslo after all; we're taking the ferry.
What time {{does the film start}} tonight? The listing says eight.
I'll lend you my notes if you {{promise}} to return them.
Don't open the box until the instructor {{tells}} you to.
Next week the Prime Minister {{is visiting|'s visiting}} Tokyo.
Our flight {{departs}} at midnight, so we need to leave early.

exercises.title: Придаточные и расписания
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present simple или present continuous (или present perfect, если это подходит).

items.text: Tara {{is getting|'s getting}} married in June.
The conference {{begins|starts}} on Monday and {{ends|finishes}} on Thursday.
Once the sun {{sets|has set|goes down|has gone down}}, the temperature will drop quickly.
If the train {{is|'s}} late, I'll take a taxi.
I'm afraid I can't join you for dinner. I {{am working|'m working}} late tomorrow.
Before you {{leave|go}}, please switch off the lights.
What {{are you doing}} this evening? Do you want to come to the cinema?

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: I ___ my dentist at 4 p.m. tomorrow.
The shop ___ at nine on Sundays.
I'll text you as soon as I ___ at the hotel.
Are you free tonight? We ___ a few friends for dinner.
We can't go out until it ___ raining.
I ___ to the gym later - do you want to come?
If you ___ me what you need, I'll order it.

options: I'll let you know when I will hear from them.
I'll let you know when I hear from them.
As soon as I will finish, I'll call you.
As soon as I finish, I'll call you.
Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
Will you wait here until I will come back?
Will you wait here until I come back?
I wonder what will happen if the project fails.
I wonder what happens if the project will fail.
items.why: После **wonder** — придаточное дополнительное: will допустим; в придаточном с if будущее не используем.

options: When you will see Anna, give her this.
When you see Anna, give her this.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, выбрав present continuous, present simple или will.

items.prompt: (I / meet / the director / at three tomorrow)
answers: I'm meeting the director at three tomorrow.
I am meeting the director at three tomorrow.

items.prompt: (the concert / start / at eight / on Saturday)
answers: The concert starts at eight on Saturday.
They are getting married in September.
They're getting married in September.
What time does the plane land tomorrow?

items.prompt: (I / call / you / as soon as / I / hear / the news)
answers: I'll call you as soon as I hear the news.
I will call you as soon as I hear the news.

items.prompt: (I / not / leave / until / you / come back)
answers: I won't leave until you come back.
I will not leave until you come back.
I'm not leaving until you come back.
I am not leaving until you come back.

exercises.title: Перепишите предложение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя present simple или present continuous вместо will.

items.prompt: The bus to the airport will leave at 5.20 tomorrow. (расписание)
answers: The bus to the airport leaves at 5.20 tomorrow.

items.prompt: We will have dinner with our clients on Thursday. (договорённость)
answers: We are having dinner with our clients on Thursday.
We're having dinner with our clients on Thursday.

items.prompt: I'll finish this report. Then I will phone you. → I'll phone you when ...
answers: I'll phone you when I finish this report.
I will phone you when I finish this report.
I'll phone you when I've finished this report.
I will phone you when I've finished this report.
I'll phone you when I have finished this report.
I will phone you when I have finished this report.

items.prompt: It may rain. We'll cancel the picnic. → We'll cancel the picnic if ...
answers: We'll cancel the picnic if it rains.
We will cancel the picnic if it rains.

items.prompt: Ask a friend about their plans for tomorrow evening. (what / do)
answers: What are you doing tomorrow evening?

items.prompt: I will not go to the party on Saturday. (договорённость, present continuous)
answers: I'm not going to the party on Saturday.
I am not going to the party on Saturday.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, используя present continuous, present simple и придаточные времени.

items.prompt: What are you doing this weekend? (договорённые планы)
items.sample: I'm having lunch with my cousin on Saturday, and on Sunday I'm visiting a museum.

items.prompt: What time does your work or school start tomorrow?
items.sample: My first lesson starts at nine tomorrow.

items.prompt: Write what you'll do as soon as you get home today.
items.sample: As soon as I get home, I'll make some tea and check my messages.

items.prompt: Write a sentence with 'if' about your plans for next weekend.
items.sample: If the weather is nice, we'll go for a picnic by the river.

items.prompt: Describe something in your city that has a fixed schedule (a bus, a film, a market).
items.sample: The market opens at seven every Saturday and closes at two.
